author: Outscaler
seen: A collagen ad from Kollo Health (shared as an example of the 'text on skin' concept): a close-up of a woman's face with small paper-style stickers stuck on her skin — "wrinkles?" and "Kollo" — and the caption "Visible results in as little as 28 days". A second version does the same on a man's face ("it's also for blokes!"). The words sit right on the skin where the problem is.

more.author: S1R3NH3AD
more.cap: saw this ad and you will never believe what i thought she was writing on her arm
